## Cost analysis

deep_einsum 265 = memory 42 + params 223. Memory is only selector plumbing: `row0` 12 B, `col0` 12 B, `rmin_t/rmin_l` 8 B, `i_b/j_b` 2 B, `row_sel/col_sel` 8 B. Params are dominated by `basis [2,3,30]` = 180, then `chan_basis [2,10]` = 20, `term_chan [3,2]` = 6, selector/slice/scalar inits = 17. The removed 810 B `[1,10,9,9]` one-hot was not forced; channel 0 is a signed low-rank sum in the final output contraction.

## Floor status

The old 1,102 floor proof is retracted. It was formulation-relative to "ch0 must also be an outer-BITAND" and missed the #109 signed-sum route: `ch0 = window - blockA - blockB` while `ch3 = blockA + blockB`. No absolute floor is claimed. The current residual cost is the shared `[2,3,30]` placement basis plus selector plumbing; any further shave must either compress that interval basis or derive the selector with fewer charged tensors.

## Don't-do log

- **§62b ch3-ONLY free-output (bitand_freeout, 1,020)**: emits NO background channel → officials 0/3, fails the gold gate. The reviewer's sub-700 recipe (K=channel-3-only) is INCOMPLETE — the grader requires ch0=1 on every in-region background cell.
- **ch0 (background) as a shared outer-BITAND**: structurally impossible (complement non-monotone + offset-reversal band-misalignment), but no longer a floor argument. Use the signed free-output sum instead.
- **Arithmetic-generative mask (gen_padlast)**: replacing the bank with runtime interval/Where mask-building REGRESSES (1,435) — each [9,9] compare plane is 81 B; 4 of them outweigh the 243 params saved.
- **Equal-tail (pad index to [1,1,30,30] then Equal-last)**: 900 B canvas > 810 B PAD-LAST one-hot for this 9×9 output — use PAD-LAST. (bitand_equaltail variant = 1,175; the single-Where assembly is leaner at 1,102.)
